problem_text:
A logistics company must coordinate 9 delivery trucks across 9 specialized loading bays. Each truck follows a predetermined route through the bays, where each stop is defined by a specific loading bay and the time required to complete the loading operation. The sequence of stops dictates the exact order in which loading operations must occur.

Truck itineraries:
* Truck 1 follows the route: Bay 7 (8 minutes) → Bay 5 (10 minutes) → Bay 1 (5 minutes) → Bay 9 (7 minutes) → Bay 2 (4 minutes) → Bay 6 (1 minute) → Bay 4 (9 minutes) → Bay 3 (9 minutes) → Bay 8 (8 minutes)
* Truck 2 follows the route: Bay 2 (3 minutes) → Bay 4 (7 minutes) → Bay 9 (8 minutes) → Bay 8 (7 minutes) → Bay 6 (5 minutes) → Bay 1 (10 minutes) → Bay 5 (4 minutes) → Bay 3 (9 minutes) → Bay 7 (1 minute)
* Truck 3 follows the route: Bay 9 (10 minutes) → Bay 7 (8 minutes) → Bay 2 (8 minutes) → Bay 6 (10 minutes) → Bay 4 (7 minutes) → Bay 8 (6 minutes) → Bay 1 (9 minutes) → Bay 5 (4 minutes) → Bay 3 (2 minutes)
* Truck 4 follows the route: Bay 5 (5 minutes) → Bay 4 (7 minutes) → Bay 3 (6 minutes) → Bay 6 (6 minutes) → Bay 7 (4 minutes) → Bay 2 (2 minutes) → Bay 9 (5 minutes) → Bay 8 (5 minutes) → Bay 1 (4 minutes)
* Truck 5 follows the route: Bay 2 (4 minutes) → Bay 4 (5 minutes) → Bay 8 (9 minutes) → Bay 5 (6 minutes) → Bay 9 (7 minutes) → Bay 3 (2 minutes) → Bay 1 (10 minutes) → Bay 6 (8 minutes) → Bay 7 (8 minutes)
* Truck 6 follows the route: Bay 2 (7 minutes) → Bay 3 (4 minutes) → Bay 6 (1 minute) → Bay 1 (10 minutes) → Bay 5 (3 minutes) → Bay 8 (1 minute) → Bay 9 (7 minutes) → Bay 7 (7 minutes) → Bay 4 (6 minutes)
* Truck 7 follows the route: Bay 7 (10 minutes) → Bay 9 (9 minutes) → Bay 1 (4 minutes) → Bay 3 (3 minutes) → Bay 4 (6 minutes) → Bay 8 (7 minutes) → Bay 5 (3 minutes) → Bay 6 (9 minutes) → Bay 2 (5 minutes)
* Truck 8 follows the route: Bay 8 (3 minutes) → Bay 4 (1 minute) → Bay 6 (1 minute) → Bay 1 (8 minutes) → Bay 3 (5 minutes) → Bay 2 (5 minutes) → Bay 5 (9 minutes) → Bay 7 (1 minute) → Bay 9 (7 minutes)
* Truck 9 follows the route: Bay 8 (1 minute) → Bay 3 (8 minutes) → Bay 1 (9 minutes) → Bay 2 (4 minutes) → Bay 7 (5 minutes) → Bay 4 (7 minutes) → Bay 6 (1 minute) → Bay 5 (7 minutes) → Bay 9 (8 minutes)

Each loading operation must proceed without interruption once initiated, and each bay can only accommodate one truck at a time. The objective is to determine the optimal scheduling sequence for all loading operations across the bays to minimize the total completion time for the entire fleet.
